description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for constructing TopicPath instances, providing methods to set various groups, criteria, channels, and other parameters relevant to topic path construction within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.

classes.name: TopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface defining a builder for creating TopicPath instances with chainable methods to set various parts of the topic path.

methods.name: things
methods.description: Sets the group of the topic path to THINGS.

methods.name: policies
methods.description: Sets the group of the topic path to POLICIES.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to SEARCH, returning a SearchTopicPathBuilder.

methods.name: commands
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to COMMANDS, returning a CommandsTopicPathBuilder.

methods.name: twin
methods.description: Sets the channel of the topic path to TWIN.

methods.name: live
methods.description: Sets the channel of the topic path to LIVE.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Sets the channel of the topic path to NONE.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to EVENTS, returning an EventsTopicPathBuilder.

methods.name: errors
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to ERRORS, returning a TopicPathBuildable.

methods.name: messages
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to MESSAGES, returning a MessagesTopicPathBuilder.

methods.name: acks
methods.description: Sets the criterion of the topic path to ACKS, returning an AcknowledgementTopicPathBuilder. Introduced in version 1.1.0.
